items.speaker: श्रीवेदव्यास उवाच
items.en: Vedavyasa said: Om. Of this great mantra, the divine hymn of the thousand names of Vishnu:

items.text:
श्रीवेदव्यासो भगवानृषिः।
अनुष्टुप् छन्दः।
श्रीमहाविष्णुः परमात्मा श्रीमन्नारायणो देवता।
अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति बीजम्‌।
items.tr:
śrīvedavyāso bhagavānṛṣiḥ|
anuṣṭup chandaḥ|
śrīmahāviṣṇuḥ paramātmā śrīmannārāyaṇo devatā|
amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānuriti bījam|
items.en: The seer is the revered Vedavyasa. The metre is Anushtup. The deity is the great Vishnu, the Supreme Self, Shriman Narayana. The seed is 'Amritamshudbhava Bhanu'.

items.text:
देवकीनन्दनः स्रष्टेति शक्तिः।
उद्भवः क्षोभणो देव इति परमो मन्त्रः।
शङ्खभृन्नन्दकी चक्रीति कीलकम्।
शार्ङ्गधन्वा गदाधर इत्यस्त्रम्।
items.tr:
devakīnandanaḥ sraṣṭeti śaktiḥ|
udbhavaḥ kṣobhaṇo deva iti paramo mantraḥ|
śaṅkhabhṛnnandakī cakrīti kīlakam|
śārṅgadhanvā gadādhara ityastram|
items.en: The power is 'Devakinandana Srashta'. The highest mantra is 'Udbhava Kshobhana Deva'. The pin (kilaka) is 'Shankhabhrit Nandaki Chakri'. The weapon is 'Sharngadhanva Gadadhara'.

items.text:
रथाङ्गपाणिरक्षोभ्य इति नेत्रम्‌।
त्रिसामा सामगः सामेति कवचम्।
आनन्दं परब्रह्मेति योनिः।
ऋतुः सुदर्शनः काल इति दिग्बन्धः॥
items.tr:
rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhya iti netram|
trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāmeti kavacam|
ānandaṃ parabrahmeti yoniḥ|
ṛtuḥ sudarśanaḥ kāla iti digbandhaḥ||
items.en: The eye is 'Rathangapani Akshobhya'. The armour is 'Trisama Samaga Sama'. The source is 'Ananda Parabrahma'. The binding of the directions is 'Ritu Sudarshana Kala'.

items.text:
श्रीविश्वरूप इति ध्यानम्‌।
श्रीमहाविष्णुप्रीत्यर्थं सहस्रनामजपे विनियोगः॥
items.tr:
śrīviśvarūpa iti dhyānam|
śrīmahāviṣṇuprītyarthaṃ sahasranāmajape viniyogaḥ||
items.en: The meditation is 'Shri Vishvarupa'. This repetition of the thousand names is done to please the great Vishnu.

items.text:
ॐ शिरसि वेदव्यासर्षये नमः।
मुखे अनुष्टुप्छन्दसे नमः।
हृदि श्रीकृष्णपरमात्मदेवतायै नमः।
गुह्ये अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति बीजाय नमः।
items.tr:
oṃ śirasi vedavyāsarṣaye namaḥ|
mukhe anuṣṭupchandase namaḥ|
hṛdi śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmadevatāyai namaḥ|
guhye amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānuriti bījāya namaḥ|
items.en: Om. On the head: salutation to the seer Vedavyasa. On the mouth: salutation to the Anushtup metre. In the heart: salutation to the deity Krishna, the Supreme Self. On the private parts: salutation to the seed 'Amritamshudbhava Bhanu'.

items.text:
पादयोर्देवकीनन्दनः स्रष्टेति शक्तये नमः।
सर्वाङ्गे शङ्खभृन्नन्दकी चक्रीति कीलकाय नमः।
करसंपूटे मम श्रीकृष्णप्रीत्यर्थे जपे विनियोगः॥
items.tr:
pādayordevakīnandanaḥ sraṣṭeti śaktaye namaḥ|
sarvāṅge śaṅkhabhṛnnandakī cakrīti kīlakāya namaḥ|
karasaṃpūṭe mama śrīkṛṣṇaprītyarthe jape viniyogaḥ||
items.en: On the feet: salutation to the power 'Devakinandana Srashta'. On the whole body: salutation to the pin 'Shankhabhrit Nandaki Chakri'. With joined palms: I use this repetition to please Lord Krishna.
Thus ends the placing of the seer and the others on the body.

items.text:
ॐ विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कार इत्यङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां नमः।
अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति तर्जनीभ्यां नमः।
ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मकृद्ब्रह्मेति मध्यमाभ्यां नमः।
सुवर्णबिन्दुरक्षोभ्य इत्यनामिकाभ्यां नमः।
items.tr:
oṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇurvaṣaṭkāra ityaṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ|
amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānuriti tarjanībhyāṃ namaḥ|
brahmaṇyo brahmakṛdbrahmeti madhyamābhyāṃ namaḥ|
suvarṇabindurakṣobhya ityanāmikābhyāṃ namaḥ|
items.en: Om. With 'Vishvam Vishnur Vashatkara': salutation to the thumbs. With 'Amritamshudbhava Bhanu': to the index fingers. With 'Brahmanyo Brahmakrid Brahma': to the middle fingers. With 'Suvarnabindur Akshobhya': to the ring fingers.

items.text:
निमिषोऽनिमिषः स्रग्वीति कनिष्ठिकाभ्यां नमः।
रथाङ्गपाणिरक्षोभ्य इति करतलकरपृष्ठाभ्यां नमः।
इति करन्यासः॥
items.tr:
nimiṣo'nimiṣaḥ sragvīti kaniṣṭhikābhyāṃ namaḥ|
rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhya iti karatalakarapṛṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ|
iti karanyāsaḥ||
items.en: With 'Nimisho Animishah Sragvi': salutation to the little fingers. With 'Rathangapani Akshobhya': to the palms and backs of the hands. Thus ends the placing on the hands.

items.text:
ॐ विश्वं विष्णुर्वषट्कार इति हृदयाय नमः।
अमृतांशूद्भवो भानुरिति शिरसे स्वाहा।
ब्रह्मण्यो ब्रह्मकृद्ब्रह्मेति शिखायै वषट्।
सुवर्णबिन्दुरक्षोभ्य इति कवचाय हुम्।
items.tr:
oṃ viśvaṃ viṣṇurvaṣaṭkāra iti hṛdayāya namaḥ|
amṛtāṃśūdbhavo bhānuriti śirase svāhā|
brahmaṇyo brahmakṛdbrahmeti śikhāyai vaṣaṭ|
suvarṇabindurakṣobhya iti kavacāya hum|
items.en: Om. With 'Vishvam Vishnur Vashatkara': salutation to the heart. With 'Amritamshudbhava Bhanu': svaha to the head. With 'Brahmanyo Brahmakrid Brahma': vashat to the tuft of hair. With 'Suvarnabindur Akshobhya': hum to the armour.

items.text:
निमिषोऽनिमिषः स्रग्वीति नेत्रत्रयाय वौषट्।
रथाङ्गपाणिरक्षोभ्य इत्यस्त्राय फट्।
इति षडङ्गन्यासः॥
items.tr:
nimiṣo'nimiṣaḥ sragvīti netratrayāya vauṣaṭ|
rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhya ityastrāya phaṭ|
iti ṣaḍaṅganyāsaḥ||
items.en: With 'Nimisho Animishah Sragvi': vaushat to the three eyes. With 'Rathangapani Akshobhya': phat to the weapon. Thus ends the placing on the six limbs.
The resolve: 'To please Lord Krishna, I will now repeat the divine thousand names of Vishnu.'
